shared_elements: rectangular hieroglyphic blocks arranged in a grid/columns
dense text covering a large flat field
rounded cartouche-like sign frames with internal detail
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by ordered grids of squarish, rounded-cornered glyph blocks filled with dense internal detail in shallow relief, a fairly specific shared writing/decorative convention rather than a generic pattern band. The decisive difference is that B also carries a full figural scene — a standing figure with raised arm, attendants and an altar-like object beneath a canopy of rays — while A shows only columns of glyph blocks with no figures or narrative relationships at all.
